project_type: Aircane Tabletop — clean-architecture ASP.NET Core 8 Web API backend (Aircane.Api/Application/Domain/Infrastructure/Workers) + Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite frontend (src/frontend/aircane-web).
build_system: dotnet SDK-style projects under src/backend; solution src/backend/Aircane.sln includes both test projects. New .cs files are globbed automatically (no csproj edit needed to add source files). Frontend: npm + Vite under src/frontend/aircane-web.
test_framework: Backend xUnit (tests/backend/Aircane.UnitTests, tests/backend/Aircane.IntegrationTests via AircaneWebApplicationFactory + EF Core InMemory). Frontend vitest.
test_command: dotnet test tests/backend/Aircane.UnitTests/Aircane.UnitTests.csproj ; dotnet test tests/backend/Aircane.IntegrationTests/Aircane.IntegrationTests.csproj ; (frontend) cd src/frontend/aircane-web && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: ALL paths are ABSOLUTE under the worktree d:\Development\aircane-tabletop\.worktrees\character-source-import. Run commands with that worktree as cwd (step-agent cwd defaults to the MAIN workspace, so pass the worktree path explicitly or cd into it). Backend: dotnet build src/backend/Aircane.sln, then dotnet test on the UnitTests then IntegrationTests csproj. Frontend: cd src/frontend/aircane-web; npm run build (typecheck) and npx vitest run. Commit locally on the branch after each FEAT; never push. Git via: git -C d:\Development\aircane-tabletop\.worktrees\character-source-import ...
environment_constraints: Windows + pwsh. Step-agent cwd is the main workspace d:\Development\aircane-tabletop, NOT the worktree — relative paths will land in the parent workspace, so use ABSOLUTE worktree paths for every file op and `cd` into the worktree (or pass --project / full paths) for every build/test/git command. Treat ALL external character JSON as untrusted: missing/null/wrong-type must never throw — emit requiresReview instead. Never store or log the D&D Beyond character URL or any secret.
contribution_requirements: Clean architecture layering: Application = mappers/detector/interface/enum/CanonicalCharacterPaths/DndBeyondPdfHints/DndBeyondSources/DTOs + IDndBeyondUrlImportService abstraction; Infrastructure = DndBeyondUrlImportService + PdfCharacterExtractor change + typed HttpClient + DI; API = CharactersController. All namespaces start 'Aircane'. REST resources plural. Frontend components PascalCase under features/characters. Server-side authorization on every endpoint (controller already has [Authorize(DmOrHost)], inherited by new actions). Feature is purely ADDITIVE — do not change existing behavior of the legacy JSON import or the PDF import shape.
key_patterns: Rail #2 (the ONLY one wired to the review/save flow): mappers produce a real Aircane.Application.Characters.CanonicalCharacter + a flat MappedFields dict keyed by ApplyMapping dotted paths (identity.name, abilities.strength, combat.armorClass, combat.maxHitPoints, combat.hitPoints, combat.speed, combat.initiative, combat.proficiencyBonus, class, level, identity.raceOrAncestry, identity.background). CharacterSchemaEngine.MapImportedFields / schema-field-ids are NOT used by this feature. CharacterService.ApplyMapping is private static, reachable only via ApplyFieldMappingsAsync (DbContext-bound); ParseIntMapping ranges: abilities 1..30, AC 0..99, hp/maxhp 0..9999, speed 0..999, initiative -20..20, proficiencyBonus 0..10, level>=1; it splits on space/'(' and TrimEnd('f','t','.'). FieldMappingEntry(string SourceFieldName REQUIRED positional, string CanonicalFieldPath, string Value). CanonicalCharacter non-zero defaults: abilities=10, AC=10, speed=30, proficiencyBonus=2 — never seed these into MappedFields. Existing PersistDraftFromExtractionAsync (PDF) DOES fall back to an Unknown/level-1 stub on ArgumentException; the NEW PersistDraftFromCanonicalAsync must NOT. Seeds: DnD5e2014Seed.DefinitionId=10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 (identifier resolvable via ISystemRegistry.ListAsync()), Pathfinder2eRemasterSeed.DefinitionId=...0003. Detector precedence by ICharacterSourceMapper.Order (GenericVtt=int.MaxValue), NOT DI order. Fixtures loaded via Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, 'Characters','Import','Fixtures', name) with CopyToOutputDirectory=PreserveNewest ItemGroup in the UnitTests csproj.
